name: Ozias
description: Son of Micha, of the tribe of Simeon; one of the governors of Bethulia who received Achior from the Israelites, comforted him and made him a feast; during the siege told the people to endure five days and trust God's mercy; was sent for by Judith and approved her words, and blessed God and Judith when she returned with Holofernes' head; sent messengers to the surrounding towns to pursue the fleeing Assyrians

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
